outputs.visual_description_en: The image is a digital graphic with an orange header and white background. The header reads "बड़ी खुशखबरी" (Big Good News). The main text, in Hindi, announces the "प्रधानमंत्री मुफ्त लैपटॉप योजना 2026" (Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026), stating that the government is providing free laptops to all students. It mentions an application deadline of "15 अक्टूबर" (October 15) and instructs users to click a link, "www.pm-free-laptop-yojana.in", to register. The bottom of the image has a red line asking to forward the message to all groups.
